## Overview

Local stress check for the **Apodemus panel path** epic
([CausalDynamics#20](https://github.com/SimonAB/CausalDynamics.jl/issues/20)):
identification → wide columns → discrete LMTP contrasts.

**Privacy:** this notebook never commits study data. Set `APODEMUS_CAUSAL_HOME`
to your local `Apodemus-superspreaders-CDMs` checkout (or rely on the standard
`~/Documents/Work/Projects/Apodemus-superspreaders/Apodemus-superspreaders-CDMs`
path when present); if unset or data are missing, a **synthetic** three-arm panel is used instead.


```{julia}
#| label: chunk-apodemus-stress-setup
#| warning: false

using CausalDynamics
using CausalDynamics:
    TemporalDAGSpec, LaggedEdge, unroll_temporal_dag, TemporalEffectQuery,
    plan_targeted_estimation, panel_column_name
using CausalTargeted
using DataFrames
using Random
using StableRNGs
using Statistics
using StatsModels  # direct dep for ApodemusCausal `include` under Quarto

const ARMS = ["R", "SS", "SC"]
const CONTRASTS = [("SS", "R"), ("SC", "R")]

# Local checkout discovery (never commits data; override with APODEMUS_CAUSAL_HOME).
if !haskey(ENV, "APODEMUS_CAUSAL_HOME")
    _apodemus_candidates = [
        expanduser("~/Documents/Work/Projects/Apodemus-superspreaders/Apodemus-superspreaders-CDMs"),
    ]
    for _candidate in _apodemus_candidates
        if isfile(joinpath(_candidate, "src", "ApodemusCausal.jl"))
            ENV["APODEMUS_CAUSAL_HOME"] = _candidate
            break
        end
    end
end

const APODEMUS_HOME = get(ENV, "APODEMUS_CAUSAL_HOME", "")

function synthetic_apodemus_wide(n::Int, T::Int, rng)
    arms = rand(rng, ARMS, n)
    cols = Dict{Symbol, Vector{Any}}(
        :mouse_id => string.(1:n),
        :grid_type => arms,
    )
    for t in 1:T
        col = panel_column_name(:fec, t)
        effect = 0.25 .* (arms .== "SS") .- 0.08 .* (arms .== "SC")
        cols[col] = effect .+ 0.05 .* randn(rng, n)
    end
    return DataFrame(cols)
end

function load_apodemus_wide(T::Int; sex::Symbol = :male)
    if !isempty(APODEMUS_HOME)
        apodemus_src = joinpath(APODEMUS_HOME, "src", "ApodemusCausal.jl")
        if isfile(apodemus_src)
            try
                mod = include(apodemus_src)
                # Julia 1.12 world age: defer binding access until inside invokelatest.
                wide = Base.invokelatest() do
                    mod.load_sentinel_wide(T; sex = sex)
                end
                return wide, :private
            catch err
                @warn "Private Apodemus load failed; using synthetic panel" exception = err
            end
        end
    end
    return synthetic_apodemus_wide(62, T, StableRNG(20260828)), :synthetic
end
```

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-apodemus-stress-planner
#| warning: false

T = 4
wide, data_source = load_apodemus_wide(T)
@info "Panel source" data_source nrow(wide)

spec = TemporalDAGSpec(
    [:grid_type, :fec],
    [LaggedEdge(:grid_type, :fec, 0)],
)
u = unroll_temporal_dag(spec, T)
query = TemporalEffectQuery(:grid_type, :fec, 2, 2)
plan = plan_targeted_estimation(
    u, query, propertynames(wide);
    unit_level = [:grid_type],
)
@info "Estimation plan" plan.engine plan.treatment plan.outcome plan.baseline
@assert plan.engine === :discrete_lmtp
@assert plan.treatment === :grid_type
@assert plan.outcome === panel_column_name(:fec, 2)
```

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-apodemus-stress-contrasts
#| warning: false

out_col = plan.outcome
sub = dropmissing(wide, [:grid_type, out_col])
opts = recommend_run_options(nrow(sub); engine = :lmtp)
rows = NamedTuple[]
for (arm_hi, arm_ref) in CONTRASTS
    res = run_estimation_plan(
        sub, plan;
        arm_hi = arm_hi,
        arm_ref = arm_ref,
        levels = ARMS,
        folds = opts.folds,
        learners_outcome = opts.learners_outcome,
        learners_trt = (:logistic, :mean),
        rng = StableRNG(20260828),
    )
    push!(
        rows,
        (;
            contrast = res.contrast,
            estimate = res.estimate,
            se = res.se,
            n = nrow(sub),
            positivity_ok = res.positivity.ok,
            source = data_source,
        ),
    )
end
result_df = DataFrame(rows)
result_df
```

## Pass criteria

- Planner selects `:discrete_lmtp` with `:grid_type` → `:fec2` (session 2).
- Both arm contrasts return finite estimates and SEs under cross-fitting.
- Positivity holds on the synthetic fixture; private runs may flag sparse arms
  (inspect `positivity_ok` only, do not print row-level data).
